candidates.change_summary: Return a different constant (zero) instead of ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Return a different constant (non-zero, distinct) instead of ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.

Invert the delegated check to allow delegated calls to succeed and non-delegated to revert, altering when proxiableUUID can be called successfully, thereby changing observable return when it completes.
Remove the call to __UUPSUpgradeable_init() so initialize does not set up UUPSUpgradeable initial state.
Change initializer so it does not set _initialized = 1, preventing marking as initialized in top-level calls.

Replace the calculation of elapsed and utilization branch so that when block.timestamp > lastUpdate it always uses IVault(_vault).utilization(_asset) for utilization (ignores index), changing returned rate.
When block.timestamp > lastUpdate, compute elapsed as 0 (so multiplier adjustments in _applySlopes see zero elapsed), changing returned rate.
When block.timestamp <= lastUpdate, set utilization to zero instead of calling IVault.utilization, altering returned rate.
Replace the kink validation condition to allow kink == 0 and reject only kink >= 1e27, changing which slope values can be set.
Remove the validation entirely so any kink value (including >=1e27) can be set, altering accepted slope configurations.
Invert the validation to accept only kink == 0 or kink < 1e27 (i.e., treat kink==0 as valid and reject others >=1e27), changing allowed settings.
Change the stored value to a different field (store slopes.kink only) so that subsequent reads of slopeData return a modified structure, altering observable behavior.
